verdict.rationale: Anytype documents Queries that answer criteria-based questions, stay up to date automatically, and assemble the results as a View. The GitHub README lists databases and kanban among its composable blocks, and a community user highlights its Notion-style databases. However, the evidence never explicitly says query criteria filter on structured properties, and table and list view layouts are not named. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Query criteria filter by object properties, explicit table/list view layouts for query results, hands-on corroboration of live query views.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can query my notes by their structured properties and render live database-style views (tables, boards, lists) from those queries

citations.quote: A Query is a question you ask your knowledge base—answered instantly and kept up to date automatically.
you define the criteria and the Query assembles the result for you as a View.
Composable blocks: text, databases, kanban, calendar & custom Types.
